title: CANS Figma mirror schemas
description: JSON Schema for the Figma-mirror state layers (Plan 02, Phase 3 — reconciled shape). Draft-07 to match the JIRA precedent (jira/manifest.schema.json). Each layer has one owner: figma/.manifest.json (figmaDomain) is the authoritative tracked-file scope; per-file figma/files/{fileKey}.json (figmaFileManifest) is the per-file page/frame inventory + that file's sync state; per-node meta figma/nodes/<slug>.meta.json (figmaNodeMeta) carries the dual-timestamp + hash sync state for one tracked node; figma/_index.json (figmaIndex) is DERIVED/regenerable and gitignored; figma/_designers.json (figmaDesigners) is a gitignored projection of .claude/config/people.json filtered to Figma-bearing people (D8). Validate any layer by referencing the matching $def, e.g. { "$ref": "manifest.schema.json#/$defs/figmaNodeMeta" }.

nodeId.description: Figma node ID in colon form, e.g. 299:12006 (Plan 02 D5). Stored verbatim in JSON; hyphen form appears only in URLs, underscore form (299_12006) only in assets/ path segments.

fileKey.description: Figma file key from the design URL (figma.com/design/{fileKey}/...).

pipeline.description: Which conversion pipeline governs this node (Plan 02 brief semantics). A = Flows / journeys (get_metadata + generate_diagram, View seat). B = Wireframes / mid-fi screens (get_metadata + get_screenshot, View seat). C = Hi-fi screens (get_design_context + get_screenshot + get_variable_defs + download_assets, Dev seat).

statusSync.description: Local sync state of a tracked node relative to its Figma source (Plan 02 §6 algorithm). Named status_sync in the payloads so it never collides with Figma's own concepts (mirrors the JIRA statusSync convention). clean = render and structure both match the last-pulled baseline; render-ahead = the exported render changed but structure did not; structure-ahead = the node subtree structure changed but the render did not; diverged = both changed; new = tracked locally but never pulled (no baseline yet); orphaned = the node is gone from the Figma source but the sidecar remains.

buildStatus.description: Code-generation coverage of the node's converted component/page (Plan 02 brief). not-built = no converted artifact exists yet; partial = some but not all of the node's frames/components have been converted; built = fully converted. (Phase-4 codegen-runtime states such as building/failed are intentionally NOT modelled in the Phase-3 mirror.)

handshakeStatus.description: Design-handshake gate state, mirroring figma/nodes/<slug>.handshake.json.status (Plan 02b F2 / Phase 5, decision BD5). not-required = internal/experimental screen exempt from the gate (or the Phase-4 hi-fi fixture); pending = a handshake exists but is not yet cleared; cleared = squad + Lumen designers + platform rep signed off with an attached a11y spec — the only value that unblocks buildStatus: built; rejected = the handshake was reviewed and knocked back. A node whose buildStatus is built while handshakeStatus is pending/rejected is surfaced as `built (⚠ handshake pending)` — never a clean built.

figmaNodeMeta.description: Per-node sync sidecar figma/nodes/<slug>.meta.json (Plan 02 §on-disk layout). One per tracked node. renderHash = hash of the exported render bytes; structureHash = order-independent hash of the node subtree structure; localEditsHash = hash of any code-side edits/annotations. Two-timestamp invariant (D4): lastSyncedAt advances only on a real pull; generatedAt advances on every reindex.

name.description: Figma layer/component name, verbatim (R1 — no de-identification).

renderHash.description: Hash of the exported render bytes as of the last pull (renderHash()).

structureHash.description: Order-independent hash of the node subtree structure (structureHash()).

localEditsHash.description: Hash of code-side edits/annotations as they currently sit on disk (localEditsHash()).

designer.description: people.json handle of the node's owning designer, or null when unattributed.

componentRef.description: Relative path to the converted component/page in apps/web (populated once buildStatus reaches partial/built by Phase 4), or null.

handshakeOverrideReason.description: Audit trail for a `/figma-to-lumen --override "<reason>"` build that bypassed the handshake gate (Phase 5 BD5). Written verbatim alongside the run log — the gate is never bypassed silently. null when no override was used.

assets.description: Relative paths of exported render/asset files for this node (e.g. figma/assets/299_12006/...). Underscore form in the path segment (D5).

artifacts.description: Relative paths of the human-readable sidecars produced for this node's pipelines (e.g. the flow .mmd for Pipeline A, the .png + .md for Pipeline B).

lastSyncedAt.description: When this node was last pulled from Figma — the drift baseline. Advances only on a real pull (D4). null until the first pull (status_sync = new).

generatedAt.description: When this sidecar was last rebuilt by a reindex. Advances on every reindex (D4).

figmaFileManifest.description: Per-file inventory figma/files/{fileKey}.json — the authoritative page/frame roster pulled for one fileKey, plus that file's last pull time and the file-level nodeTreeHash. nodes[] points at the per-node meta sidecars under figma/nodes/.

nodeTreeHash.description: Order-independent structure hash of the whole tracked node tree for this file, for a cheap file-level drift check.

pages.description: Pages in this file and the frames tracked within each (mirrors the brief's pages[]/frames[]).

frames.description: Tracked frame node IDs on this page.

nodes.description: Roster of tracked nodes in this file — the pointer + a copy of sync-critical state for a cheap read (full state is in the node meta).

lastSyncedAt.description: When this file was last pulled from Figma (D4). null until the first pull.

figmaDomain.description: figma/.manifest.json — the authoritative registry of tracked Figma files/domains + sync scope (committed, low-churn). Mirrors the JIRA domainManifest.

files.description: One entry per tracked Figma file.

defaultBranch.description: Figma branch key to track, or null for the main file.

trackedRoots.description: Root node IDs whose subtrees are tracked (empty ⇒ whole file).

pipelines.description: Pipeline tags in play for this file (A/B/C).

figmaIndex.description: figma/_index.json — DERIVED, regenerable rollup (reconciled superset). GITIGNORED (D3). Never hand-authored; rebuilt from node metas + file manifests on every sync and reindex. Two-timestamp invariant (D4): generatedAt = last rebuild; lastSyncedAt = last remote pull (reindex must NOT touch lastSyncedAt).

generatedAt.description: Last reindex time. Advances on every rebuild.

lastSyncedAt.description: Last remote pull time. null at fresh init until the first real pull (D4 timestamp invariant); reindex must never touch it.

counts.description: Aggregate counts (e.g. byStatus, byPipeline, byBuildStatus totals).

files.description: One-line summary per tracked file (fileKey → name + tracked-node count + last pull).

items.description: One-line summaries of every tracked node. The agent answers most prompts from here, drilling into a node meta only for full detail.

frameTree.description: Reverse lookup: fileKey → page nodeId → tracked frame node IDs. The nesting view the /figma tree command renders.

componentUsage.description: Reverse lookup: component/library reference → node IDs that use it (the /figma uses command). Empty until Phase-4 component refs exist.

buildCoverage.description: Build-coverage rollup by bucket (the /figma coverage command).

mapsTo.description: Node → converted artifact edges (nodeId ↔ componentRef). Empty in Phase 3; Phase 4 codegen populates it.

byPipeline.description: Reverse lookup: pipeline tag → node IDs.

byDesigner.description: Reverse lookup: designer handle → node IDs.

byStatus.description: Reverse lookup: status_sync value → node IDs.

figmaDesigners.description: figma/_designers.json — DERIVED, GITIGNORED projection of .claude/config/people.json filtered to people with a Figma handle (D8). Never a separate roster; regenerated from people.json.

generatedAt.description: When this projection was last rebuilt from people.json.

designers.description: One entry per person carrying a Figma handle.

aliases.description: Alias list carried through from people.json, for the agent's alias resolution.

figma.description: Figma account handle / email, verbatim from people.json.
